verdict.rationale: Solid's docs say that when state changes, only the code depending on it reruns. Dependency tracking is automatic, and components run once to set up real DOM nodes, so developers write no diffing code. Community reports back this up, crediting Solid with finally realizing fine-grained reactive updates and squeezing exceptional performance from the DOM. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the compiler/JSX transform (only implied by the `jsx: preserve` / `jsxImportSource` config and a mention of dom-expressions), and hands-on evidence of what the compiled output looks like.
